text:
Anna (support): heads up — Enterprise customer `acme-inc` opened an escalation: sudden p95/p99 spike after we enabled the new int8 quant profile on their Dedicated pool. They started seeing 2-3x p99 for chat completions since last config push. logs + sample request below.

Diego (eng-runtime): thanks. can you paste the earliest request ts and a sample curl? any model/version pinned? :eyes: 

Anna (support): earliest noticed 2103456701, repro curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"gptx-3.2","input":"summarize: ...","max_tokens":256}'`

Anna (support): current model config on their Dedicated pool: `{"model":"gptx-3.2","quantization":"int8","calibration_dataset":"small_docs_v1","fallback_to_fp16":true}`

Priya (eng-ml): hmm. calibration_dataset `small_docs_v1` is borderline — we saw skew for long context tokens which can trigger extra rematerialization in the runtime. do we have kernel fallback logs?

Anna (support): attached log excerpt from their region (anonymized):
```
[2103456710] request_id=abc123 start
[2103456710] model=gptx-3.2.quant=int8 seq_len=1024 alloc_kv=ok
[2103456711] kernel_select: int8_kv_matmul failed -> fallback fp16_kernel
[2103456711] runtime: recompile kernels, allocate fallback buffers
[2103456712] request_id=abc123 p95=540ms p99=1.2s
[2103456712] request_id=def456 p95=510ms p99=1.1s
```

Diego (eng-runtime): kernel fallback lines are the smoking gun. int8 kernel failing on that HW path causes dynamic fallback to fp16 which adds recompile overhead + buffer copies. that explains the p99 spikes. any recent driver/OS updates on their Dedicated hosts?

Anna (support): customer says they haven't changed infra. We toggled quant profile 2103456600 as part of an optimization roll.

Priya (eng-ml): two likely causes: 1) quant kernel mismatch with sequence length distribution (int8 path assumes small seqs), 2) calibration mismatch — calibration produced extremes causing value clipping and kernel guard debugs. quick checks: run micro-benchmarks compare `int8 vs fp16 vs fp8` on same image; run `rwd-quant-verify --model gptx-3.2 --profile int8 --seq 1024`.

Diego (eng-runtime): immediate mitigation: revert quant profile for that pool (set `quantization: fp16`) to eliminate kernel fallback overhead. we should do a canary revert first. I'll push a canary change to 5% of their requests.

deploy-bot: canary deploy initiated for tenant acme-inc pool-42 -> 5% -> config set `quantization: fp16`

Kai (oncall): I'll watch traces. set temporary alert: p99 > 800ms for tenant acme-inc to page oncall.

Anna (support): customer asked whether we can keep cost savings but avoid regressions — they prefer FP16 over 2x slower int8 right now.

Priya (eng-ml): long-term options: 1) recalibrate int8 with a larger / representative dataset (use `large_dialogs_v3`), 2) enable selective layerwise fp16 fallback in quant profile (mixed quant), 3) try fp8 experiments but it's risky without stable kernels. for immediate RCA: capture a failing batch with `RWD_RUNTIME_DEBUG=1` to see exact kernel failure reason.

Diego (eng-runtime): created ENG-1298: "int8 kernel fallback on 3.2 when seq>=512 causing p99 spike". assigning to @Priya and @Diego. Priority P1 for Dedicated customers experiencing >2x regressions.

Priya (eng-ml): repro steps I used locally:
```
# reproduce locally (devbox w/ similar GPU)
rwd-bench --model gptx-3.2 --profile int8 --seq 1024 --batch 1 --warmup 50 --iter 200 > bench_int8.log
rwd-bench --model gptx-3.2 --profile fp16 --seq 1024 --batch 1 --warmup 50 --iter 200 > bench_fp16.log
# then compare p95/p99
rwd-compare bench_int8.log bench_fp16.log
```

Priya (eng-ml): my local numbers: int8 p95=480ms p99=950ms, fp16 p95=460ms p99=470ms. int8 p99 shows long tail due to occasional kernel fallback.

Anna (support): customer asks for rollback ETA and whether they'll be billed for the extra tail. can billing be adjusted?

Diego (eng-runtime): ETA for canary rollback immediate, full rollback within 10 minutes if canary looks good. Billing adjustment — finance needs to approve credits; open support case to request usage credit for the window. I'll flag billing.

Anna (support): opened case FIN-5642 asking for provisional credit for acme-inc for the span 2103456600-2103456800. linked to support ticket SUP-9876.

Kai (oncall): canary metrics: at +6m p99 down to 420ms on canary cohort. No new kernel_fallback logs in canary.

deploy-bot: canary reached success threshold -> promoting to 100% for pool-42 -> set `quantization: fp16`

Diego (eng-runtime): rolling rollback complete. removed int8 profile from acme pool and pinned fp16. created follow-up actions:
- add runtime metric `quant_kernel_fallback_count` exported per tenant
- add preflight validation when enabling quant profiles: run `rwd-quant-verify` offline or in a short canary (seq distribution sampling)
- document calibration dataset requirements in tenant onboarding

Priya (eng-ml): follow-ups for model infra:
- implement mixed-precision profiles allowing per-layer override to avoid full int8 path
- improve quant calibration tool to detect outliers and warn if calibration uses non-representative dataset

Anna (support): I told customer rollback is done, p99 normalized, finance is looking at credits. they asked for a postmortem and timeline for safe re-enable.

Diego (eng-runtime): I'll draft a short postmortem and a safe checklist for enabling quantization on Dedicated:
```
Safe enable checklist:
1) sample seq distribution from 24h of traffic
2) run rwd-quant-verify with sampled seqs
3) run 5% canary with `quantization:int8` for 1h, monitor `quant_kernel_fallback_count` and p99
4) if fallback_count>0 then revert and escalate to eng-ml
```

Priya (eng-ml): I'll run calibration with `large_dialogs_v3` and attempt a mixed-precision profile. will update ENG-1298 with calibration artifacts and bench logs.

Anna (support): thanks everyone. I'll update the customer and close SUP-9876 once finance confirms credits. :thumbsup:

Kai (oncall): tagging final notes: set alert baseline for 24h to detect any regression after re-enable attempts. I'll also schedule a quick runbook entry for oncall (how to revert quant profile).

rwd-calc-bot: scheduled job `quant-verify-acme-210345` queued by Priya.

Diego (eng-runtime): closing thread for now; keep ENG-1298 active. if anyone hits a different tenant with similar symptoms, ping here. :raised_hands:
